text_block_list.text:
I need to make sure of my position on the 
hill in the early stages...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'm beginning to picture it now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This Kobe Shimbun Hai is a 2,400-meter 
turf race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you recall all the training you have 
done so far, there will be no issue.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Without letting my guard down, I will 
firmly seize victory!
